Build against Acme Notes API S21 api_version v1 with base path AX-25930 and error format AX-78362. The api_version values of other sprints (S01-S20) are older and do not govern S21; the S21 facts agree with repo/api.py.

Use the security team's JWT bearer tokens (RS256) for all user traffic; this governs over Globex's request for a long-lived X-Api-Key because long-lived static keys are weaker and cannot be tied to an interactive user session. The Globex request is not adopted for user traffic; it is deferred as a possible separate, scoped, revocable service-credential for non-interactive back-office scripts, to be evaluated by the security team.

Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing API cycle ("quarterly, invoiced on day 7") and the S13 key header ("API key in X-Core-Key header"). For S13 the researcher's JWT auth_method fact names no key header, so the planner's X-Core-Key fact governs the header question.
Adopt API v2 per the researcher's updated api_version fact for Acme Notes API S21; it supersedes the earlier version, so endpoint design must be updated for v2.

Approve the crud spec. API version v2 (S21) governs; the other sprints' api_version facts are for other sprints. Two S21 auth_method facts disagree (researcher: JWT RS256, earlier; planner: API key in X-Api-Key, later, from the t05 auth choice). The planner's later auth choice governs; the JWT fact is noted as the superseded survey option.

Approve the CRUD spec: API version v2 is consistent with the recorded S21 fact. Caveats: S21 has two active auth_method facts (JWT RS256 and API key in X-Api-Key), and the memory values for auth.token_ttl and db.engine differ from the current code, so the code values are used in the review.
